profile.name: Jethro Navarro

projects.title: Normalized Playlist REST API
projects.shortDescription: FastAPI & SQLAlchemy 2.0 service managing many-to-many playlist catalogs without duplicate song entities.
projects.fullDescription: Production-grade RESTful service with Pydantic v2 validation, SQLite foreign key enforcement, and cascade rules ensuring catalog integrity.
projects.contribution: Architected normalized many-to-many junction schema, built CRUD endpoints in FastAPI, and wrote comprehensive pytest suites with HTTPX.
objectives: Support cross-playlist song sharing without duplicating song records.
Enforce strict cascading deletes for playlist entries while preserving song entities.
Ensure 100% automated test coverage across edge cases and foreign key constraints.
projects.approach: Relational schema design with an explicit PlaylistSong junction table, composite indexing, and SQLite foreign key PRAGMA enforcement.
projects.implementation: FastAPI dependency-injected database sessions, Pydantic DTOs for request/response serialization, and encapsulated CRUD query functions.
challenges: SQLite foreign key enforcement requiring explicit PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON listener configuration.
Preventing duplicate song additions to the same playlist via composite unique constraints.
iterations: v2: Relational SQLite migration with SQLAlchemy ORM models.
v3: Comprehensive pytest test client suite with isolated test databases.
projects.results: 100% test pass rate across all CRUD suites with sub-millisecond local endpoint response times and complete data normalization.
projects.lessonsLearned: Explicit relational junction models ensure scalable data deduplication without complex ORM magic.

projects.title: OpsTracker: Attendance & Inventory System
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack operations hub integrating workforce attendance tracking with real-time warehouse inventory management.
projects.fullDescription: Local-first enterprise operations dashboard combining employee punch kiosk, presence boards, and inventory replenishment with stock underflow protection.
projects.contribution: Built FastAPI backend routes, designed SQLite transactional schema, and engineered modern vanilla ES6+ reactive dashboard UI.
objectives: Provide 1-click check-in/out with automated shift duration calculation.
Prevent warehouse inventory underflow with atomic transactional balance validation.
Generate filterable historical timesheets with 1-click CSV export.
projects.approach: Unified dual-domain architecture coupling workforce telemetry with real-time warehouse logistics in an offline-first environment.
projects.implementation: RESTful FastAPI service with structured SQLite persistence, paired with a vanilla ES6 modular frontend using CSS custom properties.
challenges: Preventing negative stock levels during concurrent rapid replenishment and dispatch.
Accurate shift duration and late arrival detection based on dynamic work schedules.
iterations: v1: Separate attendance and inventory CLI scripts.
v2: Unified FastAPI backend with unified database transactions.
v3: Executive web dashboard with real-time KPI cards and CSV export.
projects.results: Zero stock underflow errors, instant 1-click punch processing, and seamless CSV audit exports.
projects.lessonsLearned: Atomic server-side balance validation is essential before committing stock dispatch deltas.

v3: Spaced recall challenge implementations with zero syntax references.
projects.results: Verified solutions across 50+ algorithmic scenarios with complete edge-case handling.
projects.lessonsLearned: Writing adversarial trap tests first forces disciplined edge-case architecture before code implementation.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio & Local CMS Engine
projects.shortDescription: Native Node.js HTTP portfolio application with zero npm dependencies, atomic versioning, and diagnostic audit engine.
projects.fullDescription: Localhost-first developer portfolio and content management system featuring timing-safe SHA-256 session auth, strict traversal security boundaries, and automated health checks.
projects.contribution: Engineered native Node.js HTTP server, implemented timing-safe SHA-256 session auth, designed atomic snapshot storage, and built automated diagnostic engine.
objectives: Zero external npm dependencies or CDN references for total offline reliability.
Enforce strict directory traversal and private file security boundaries.
Automate comprehensive health, link, asset, and schema diagnostics.
projects.approach: Native Node.js standard library architecture with clean separation between public assets, admin API routes, and isolated private storage.
projects.implementation: Timing-safe authentication, atomic file writes with timestamped JSON history, and a 56-rule diagnostic audit engine.
challenges: Blocking directory traversal without using third-party web frameworks.
Ensuring 100% offline functionality with zero external fonts or CDN dependencies.
iterations: v2: Native Node.js HTTP routing with REST API.
v3: CMS admin dashboard with atomic backups, version restore, and automated diagnostics.
projects.results: 100% Diagnostic Health Score across 56 validation rules and zero security boundary leaks.
projects.lessonsLearned: Standard library HTTP primitives provide exceptional security, speed, and zero supply-chain overhead.
